title: Gold’s Gym
intro: Studies of strength, movement and gold. A sequence of AI-assisted fitness image explorations.

sources.label: RANDOM-ORDER-X-HA / V2 / Build Experiment Test / Gold’s Gym

blocks.label: Visual direction
blocks.body: A warm gold palette, hard gym light and traces of movement connect a sequence of fitness image studies.

blocks.label: Creative process
blocks.body: Generative image-making explores strength and movement through pose, atmosphere and cinematic lighting. The images are presented as AI-assisted concept studies.

blocks.label: Structured direction
blocks.body: The visual brief centres on four recurring elements: strength, movement, cinematic lighting and a gold-led palette. Together, they provide a consistent direction across the individual studies.
